invariants: The registrar receives explicit values and reads no environment (bootstrap-registrars rule).
The group is staged, not built: the factory creates the WorkCatalog only when the frozen registry is consumed.
responsibilities: WorkCatalogFactory: creates the frozen WorkCatalog from the staged project values.
register_catalog: stage the catalog as a forge-core bootstrap PreparedGroup (id forge.work.catalog, provides work-catalog).
summary: The catalog's bootstrap wiring: a factory over staged project values and the registrar that stages it as a frozen group.
